color.note: Background is a warm GREIGE, not white. Accent is pure electric yellow used on both fills and text. Dark sections are PURE black.

typography.critical_finding: Mid-level headings are weight 500 (MEDIUM), not bold. Only the wordmark/h1 reach 700. Body and nav links are 12.8px — very small.

shape.note: Small radii (~7-11px) plus pills. No large 24-28px card radii.

elevation.note: ZERO box-shadows site-wide. Depth comes from glass translucency, borders and the fixed blurred photo — never drop shadows.

motion.libraries: GSAP 3.15 (ScrollTrigger, Flip, SplitText, DrawSVG, MotionPath) + Lenis 1.1.18 + Swiper 11
motion.properties_animated: scale, opacity, blur, yPercent, clipPath — never layout props
motion.scrub_vs_oneshot: 5 scrubbed vs 3 toggleActions — scrub is rationed

design_style.mood: Confident, editorial, warm-neutral. Craft-forward but not precious.
design_style.personality: Design-engineer showing off control — big type, restrained surfaces, one loud accent.
design_style.composition: Giant display type owns hierarchy; everything else is deliberately quiet and small.
design_style.whitespace: Generous vertical rhythm; content sits on a warm ground rather than white.
design_style.ornamentation: Low. One accent colour, no shadows, no gradients-as-decoration.

fixed_blurred_photo_backdrop.note: profile-img-wrap is position:fixed z-10; GSAP scrubs blur onto it so it becomes ambient texture

pinned_horizontal_scroll.note: projects section 4 viewports tall; .work-sticky track 4138px wide in 1280px window, overflow hidden, translateX scrubbed
